name.pt-BR: O Pecado e as Suas Consequências

description.en-US: Manning's eight Lenten sermons of 1874, preached at the Pro-Cathedral, Kensington: the nature of sin, mortal sin, venial sin, sins of omission, the grace and works of penance, temptation, the dereliction on the cross and the joys of the Resurrection.
description.pt-BR: Os oito sermões quaresmais de Manning (1874), pregados na Pró-Catedral de Kensington: a natureza do pecado, o pecado mortal, o pecado venial, os pecados de omissão, a graça e as obras da penitência, a tentação, o abandono na cruz e as alegrias da Ressurreição.

en-US.editor: Henry Edward Manning (London: Burns and Oates, 1874)

sources.edition: Sin and its Consequences (London: Burns and Oates, 1874), University of Toronto scan, Internet Archive full-text OCR.
sources.description: The eight sermons; the contents and the publisher's advertisements are dropped. Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw OCR in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Cardinal Henry Edward Manning died in 1892 and the edition is of 1874, so the text is public domain.

title.en-US: Sermon I. The Nature of Sin
